title: Canonical etale derived adjunction on ordinary chain transposes
statement:
Let $r:W\to V$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $R$ any commutative ring. Work with sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves on small etale sites and the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $r_R^*\dashv r_{*,R}$ for the exact module inverse-image adjunction [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Let $Q$ be localization and let $\alpha_K:Q(r_{*,R}K)\to Rr_{*,R}(QK)$ be the canonical right-derived comparison, defined using K-injective resolutions [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived].

There is a canonical derived adjunction $r_R^*\dashv Rr_{*,R}$, with $r_R^*$ represented termwise. For any cochain complexes $M$ on $V$ and $K$ on $W$, and any chain map $f:M\to r_{*,R}K$, its Hom bijection satisfies
$$e_R(\alpha_K\circ Qf)=Q(f^\flat),\qquad f^\flat=\varepsilon^0_K\circ r_R^*f:r_R^*M\to K,$$
where the right side uses the canonical exact-pullback identification $r_R^*(QM)\cong Q(r_R^*M)$. The maps $\alpha_K$ and this formula are natural in chain maps in both variables. In particular, setting $M=r_{*,R}K$ and $f=1$ gives
$$\varepsilon_{QK}\circ r_R^*(\alpha_K)=Q(\varepsilon^0_K).$$
No boundedness, acyclicity, flatness or properness assumption is required.
